vectors.name: valid/single-entry
vectors.note: A created log.

vectors.name: valid/key-agreement
vectors.note: A document with an X25519 keyAgreement key and a DIDComm service (what a mediator reads).

vectors.name: valid/rotation-without-prerotation
vectors.note: Entry 2 is signed by the keys of entry 1 and introduces k1; entry 3 is signed by k1.

vectors.name: valid/version-number
vectors.note: Selecting version 2 of three.

vectors.name: valid/prerotation
vectors.note: Each entry is signed by a key the entry before committed to; the last ends pre-rotation.

vectors.name: valid/deactivated
vectors.note: The latest version of a deactivated DID has no document.

vectors.name: valid/deactivated-earlier-version
vectors.note: An earlier version of a deactivated DID still resolves, flagged deactivated.

vectors.name: invalid/first-entry-edited
vectors.note: The document of the first entry was changed after the SCID was computed.

vectors.name: invalid/later-entry-edited
vectors.note: The document of a later entry was changed: its entry hash no longer matches.

vectors.name: invalid/other-did
vectors.note: A valid log, presented for a different SCID.

expect.reason: not the SCID of the DID

vectors.name: invalid/not-a-vh-did
vectors.note: The DID is of another method.

vectors.name: invalid/unsigned
vectors.note: An entry with no proof.

vectors.name: invalid/signed-by-unauthorised-key
vectors.note: Entry 2 is signed by k3, which no entry authorised.

vectors.name: invalid/signed-by-previous-keys-after-rotation
vectors.note: Entry 3 is signed by k0 although entry 2 replaced k0 with k1.

vectors.name: invalid/prerotation-uncommitted-key
vectors.note: Entry 2 authorises k3, which entry 1 did not commit to.

vectors.name: invalid/prerotation-update-keys-not-restated
vectors.note: Entry 2 omits updateKeys while pre-rotation is active.

vectors.name: invalid/prerotation-next-key-hashes-not-restated
vectors.note: Entry 2 omits nextKeyHashes while pre-rotation is active.

vectors.name: invalid/version-number-gap
vectors.note: Entry 2 is numbered 3.

vectors.name: invalid/time-not-increasing
vectors.note: Entry 2 has the same versionTime as entry 1.

vectors.name: invalid/time-in-the-future
vectors.note: Entry 2 is a year after the resolver's now.

vectors.name: invalid/time-with-fraction
vectors.note: Entry 2's versionTime has fractional seconds.

vectors.name: invalid/document-id-is-the-did-with-src
vectors.note: Entry 2's document id carries a ?src=.

vectors.name: invalid/document-id-is-another-did
vectors.note: Entry 2's document id is another did:vh.

vectors.name: invalid/portable
vectors.note: A parameter of another DID method, which did:vh does not define.

vectors.name: invalid/log-version
vectors.note: VH-Log's own version parameter, which a specialisation that designates its own must not use.

vectors.name: invalid/unknown-parameter
vectors.note: A parameter did:vh does not define.

vectors.name: invalid/null-parameter
vectors.note: null stands for nothing in a parameter.

vectors.name: invalid/method-is-another
vectors.note: The method of another DID method.

vectors.name: invalid/scid-in-later-entry
vectors.note: parameters.scid in a later entry.

vectors.name: invalid/entry-after-deactivation
vectors.note: An entry follows the deactivating entry.

vectors.name: invalid/witness-not-supported
vectors.note: A witness configuration is refused rather than ignored.

vectors.name: invalid/two-version-selectors
vectors.note: More than one of versionId, versionTime and versionNumber.

vectors.name: invalid/version-not-found
vectors.note: A version the log does not have.

shadows.name: valid/derived
shadows.note: The derivation: the DID replaced in ids, controllers and references (also followed by #, ? or /), alsoKnownAs reduced to the did:vh DID, relative references and other strings untouched.

shadows.name: invalid/extra-member
shadows.note: A member the derivation does not give.

shadows.name: invalid/missing-member
shadows.note: A member the derivation gives is missing.

shadows.name: invalid/other-key
shadows.note: A verification key that is not the did:vh document's.

shadows.name: invalid/extra-service
shadows.note: A service the did:vh document does not have.

shadows.name: invalid/also-known-as-extra
shadows.note: alsoKnownAs names more than the did:vh DID.

shadows.name: invalid/also-known-as-keeps-vh-document-names
shadows.note: alsoKnownAs copied from the did:vh document instead of reduced.

shadows.name: invalid/id-not-the-web-did
shadows.note: The document's id is another did:web.

shadows.name: invalid/vh-id-left-in-place
shadows.note: The did:vh DID was not replaced.

shadows.name: invalid/vh-document-does-not-name-the-web-did
shadows.note: The did:vh document does not list this did:web DID: the link is one-way.

shadows.name: invalid/vh-document-names-nothing
shadows.note: The did:vh document lists no alias at all.
